transcript:
alex: Heads-up — overnight run on long-context workload showed a sharp eviction burst and weird residency drop. Can someone eyeball?

maria: which metrics / time window?

alex: Looking at 5m windows around 2026-03-15T03:10Z. Prom snapshot: kv_evictions_total increase from ~8/min -> ~140/min for a handful of pods; apparent residency p50 down 65% -> 38%; kv_fragmentation_ratio doubled ~0.05 -> 0.11.

sachin: do we have labels on the eviction counter? model/pod/shard?

alex: eviction counter has model,pod,shard_id. The spike aligns with heavy traffic to model `redwood-long-13b` with seq_len > 5k.

jena: sounds like long contexts + compaction lag. Any ops alerts at the same time?

ops-bot: alert: pod_preemptions_high namespace=redwood-runtime at 2026-03-15T03:11:30Z count=6 in 1m

maria: that could have stalled compaction workers. Two possibles: real pressure causing evictions, or sampler bias underreporting residency for long sessions.

sachin: instrumentation notes:
- eviction metric currently lacks reason; add `eviction_reason` label (capacity|ttl|compaction|manual).
- emit `kv_eviction_age_seconds` histogram at eviction time so we can see if we evict very young pages.
- sample `kv_session_page_count` for 1% sessions to compute true residency distribution.

alex: current PromQLs I used:
```
sum(increase(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (pod)
avg(kv_fragmentation_ratio) by (pod)
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(kv_residency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, pod))
```

sachin: histogram_quantile over low-card buckets is noisy. Better to compute p50/p90 per session and then aggregate. Also consider adding `kernel_variant_used{model,pod}` metric to correlate kernel switches with memory behavior.

maria: dashboard proposals:
- heatmap: eviction_rate by model,pod (24h)
- session-residency: p50/p90 by model (session-scoped compute)
- fragmentation + compaction_backlog panel
- eviction_age histogram panel

jena: I'll draft a small per-model drilldown tile on runtime -> kv-cache so SRE/product can zoom fast.

sachin: quick implementation plan: add eviction_reason label (cheap), emit eviction_age histogram, add kernel_variant_used gauge when kernel switches. We'll watch cardinality.

alex: For triage I'm going to run a focused replay of `redwood-long-13b` in staging with compaction tuned to aggressive: compaction_interval=20s and enable full-session sampling for 2% of sessions.

jena: please attach heap/kv snapshots + traces. If repro is stable we'll make a runbook.

maria: suggested alert rule: firing when model eviction_rate > 30/min sustained for 3 consecutive 5m windows OR fragmentation_ratio > 0.1 for 15m.

sachin: add a sampler job: every 15m pick 1% sessions and do a full residency walk to validate our streaming sampler.

alex: quick PromQL I'd like to add once eviction_age is present:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kv_eviction_age_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```

jena: PR checklist: dashboards + alert, metric + tests, replay artifacts, ticket with timeline and screenshots.

maria: I'll own dashboard + alert (ETA 3h). Will annotate ops-bot preemption events on the panels.

sachin: I'll own metric PR (eviction_reason + eviction_age + kernel_variant_used) (ETA EOD). Will include load test validation.

alex: I'll run 3 staged replays (ETA 2h). If compaction tweaks reduce evictions consistently we can prod to prod-change.

jena: filing ticket now and linking this thread. tagging @sachin @maria @alex

alex: follow-up: staging run done, eviction spikes reduced when compaction_interval=20s. attached heap diffs in ticket. repro consistent 4/4 runs.

maria: dashboard PR opened. added eviction heatmap, session p50/p90, eviction_age and compaction backlog.

sachin: metric PR merged. eviction_reason, kv_eviction_age_seconds histogram, kernel_variant_used emitted. watch for small card increases.

jena: ticket updated with links to dashboards/PRs/traces and a short remediation plan (compaction tuning, alert tuning, sampler validation, kernel telemetry).

alex: thanks all—closing for now. will reopen if we see regression in prod :rocket:

jena: thanks everyone, great cross-team response :thumbsup:
